usage: agentbreeder build [-h] [--environment ENVIRONMENT] [--locked |
                          --update [REF ...]] [--offline] [--output OUTPUT]
                          [--json] [--stack DIR]
                          agent

positional arguments:
  agent

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --environment ENVIRONMENT
                        Operator environment to build the manifest for
  --locked              Refuse any agent.lock change
  --update [REF ...]    Accept new hashes for path refs (all or listed)
  --offline             Never use the network: remote registry sources come
                        from the cache only
  --output OUTPUT       Where to write manifests (default ./deploy)
  --json
  --stack DIR           Use the operator config and state that `services up`
                        wrote for DIR
